newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Bahari to float 50 mln shares in mid-June.
newsitem.headline: Bank Bahari to float 50 mln shares in mid-June.

text.p: Indonesia's Bank Bahari announced on Monday that it will float 50 million shares at 925 rupiah each to raise about 46.25 billion rupiah.
In an advertisement in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper, the company said the three-day offer period will start on June 9 ahead of a listing on the Jakarta stock exchange on July 1.
Bahari said that 65 percent of the proceeds will be used to increase its lending activity, 15 percent to expand its network and 15 percent to expand its automated teller machines.
The remaining five percent will be allocated to finance its human resources development, Bahari said.
Local brokerage firm PT Trimegah Securindolestari will act as lead underwriter.
